item.title: Version 1.0.4
item.description:
Breaking changes

  • rename the app to Amperscope

New

  • Mac / iPhone device switcher with iPhone placeholder
  • battery temperature from the gauge's HID sensor
  • app-icon battery glyph with optional percentage inside
  • four-step welcome
  • appearance settings
  • themed dashboard surfaces
  • themed battery charts
  • theme tokens, persistence and window appearance
  • Sparkle public key
  • Sparkle 2.10.1 with Check for Updates and a Debug-safe policy
  • build, sign and notarize script
  • tag script with dry run
  • commit classifier, release notes and appcast appender
  • layout hardening for de/fr and documentation
  • German and French translations
  • route all UI copy through the String Catalog
  • locale-aware number, percent and duration formatting
  • stable CSV tokens independent of display labels
  • add String Catalog, sync script and catalog lint tests

Fixed

  • review round 1
  • Follow Mac restores the system appearance
  • tokenise chart footer and scope empty-state styling
  • visible charging dashes, opaque plug badge, separate area series
  • use paused token for notCharging, localize Follow Mac as Automatisch/Automatique
  • publish only via manual dispatch (no required reviewers on this plan)
  • query the approval gate live
  • require the pinned xcodegen version locally
  • compare published assets by content
  • refuse non-increasing build numbers; code-span note subjects
  • verify Sparkle signature against the app's public key
  • distinct step label for the dSYM UUID check
  • verify resume state before pushing
  • layout min height, drop dead SampleTrigger.label, sort sources by displayed name, scale factor
  • fill-width card rows, charge chart priority and minimum height
  • rigid card row variants, equal widths, shared popover state
  • keep telemetry unreadable reason locale-free, localize in the view
  • treat %arg as the substitution format specifier in lint
  • positional placeholders, substitutions, and lint helper fixture tests
